text:
marta: Heads-up — EU-west saw an unexpected evening burst starting ~20:08 UTC, GPU util jumped to 92% on the slab nodes. Observed tokens/sec ~1.2M across the region, concurrent active requests ~6.4k. Can infra do a quick what-if on adding 2x temporary slab nodes vs adjusting batching? :eyes:

jason: grabbing logs now. Any correlation with scheduled jobs or customer canaries?

marta: not from cron, looks client-driven. Traffic skewed to longer generations (avg seq len 420 -> 710).

priya: running a quick sim — if avg seq up to 700, tokens/sec per GPU drops ~16% because of KV/warmup and longer per-request time. Need to repro with our micro-sim.

kai: I pushed a one-off sim script to the infra sandbox, run like:
```
# run sim
python sim.py --region eu-west --nodes 12 --avg_seq 700 --concurrency 6400
```

kai: sim result: with current pool (12 GPUs) latency SLO violated at 75th pct; effective headroom ~-8% (we're over capacity). Adding 2 GPUs restores ~12% headroom but increases monthly GPU-hrs by ~144h.

sandeep: can we instead tweak batching/window? If we lower max_batch_delay from 12ms -> 6ms we reduce tail amplification but increase token cost ~3% (more small batches).

marta: quick cost thought: 144h extra at $1.20/hr = $172.80 — vs 3% token cost bump on current monthly EU spend. Which is cheaper short-term?

priya: quick calc: current monthly token cost for EU workload ~ $14,000. 3% bump ~= $420 — so batching tweak is cheaper for immediate 48h mitigation, but leaves little margin for further spikes.

jason: proposal: implement batching tweak as short-term mitigation + spin 1 spot/reserved burst node as buffer for next 48h. Also update routing to send low-importance batch to quantized-small variant during evening shoulder.

marta: agreed. I'll open a tiny runbook. @deploy-bot can you schedule 1 spot node in eu-west for 48h with auto-drain at end?

deploy-bot: scheduled spot-node-383 in eu-west, expires in 48h. :white_check_mark:

kai: added an alert rule: avg_seq > 600 && gpu_util > 85% -> page on-call + slack notify. Also logged sim outputs to /mnt/sims/eu-evening-2115554321.csv.

sandeep: I'll push the batching change behind a FF; rollout to 10% first and monitor p95/p99.

marta: Great. Follow-ups: cost owners reconcile monthly forecast for evening seq skew, update capacity model to include seq-length distribution shifts, and add a note to next capacity sync. Thanks all :rocket:
